headline: Where to find Wumpo
title: Where to Find Wumpo | Astral Mountains Hauler | Palworld Guide
video_script: Need a heavy hauler in Palworld one point zero? Wumpo is a great pick. Look for it in the frozen Astral Mountains in the far north, usually around level forty and up, so bring cold resistant gear. Its Transporting suitability is level six, and it can be ridden too. Put one on your base conveyor duty and watch the loot move. Which Pal hauls for you? Comment below!
description: Wumpo in Palworld 1.0 lives in the frozen Astral Mountains and has Transporting level six for base hauling.
